CustomField.description: INC0123192 2021-02-24 Missing approval assignment (due to missing user level). Should only happen in new approvals, but just in case, adding here too. INC0137001 Opp Reg Approval Timestamp Calculations add "Ext"
CustomField.formula:
IF( Opp_Reg_Approval_Assignment__c =0,"Please contact Channel Ops, Approval Assignment is missing. ","") & IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Extension Pending"),LEN(TEXT(Opp_Reg_Approval_Assignment__c))=0),"Missing Approval Assignment Group. ","") + IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Extension Pending"),or_New_Opp_Reg__c=TRUE),"New Deal must be de-selected for extension Deal Reg approval. ","")+
IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Extension Pending"),NOT(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Approval_Flow_Status__c,"Approvals not started"))),"Approval Flow Status must be 'Approvals not started.' ","")+
IF(AND(ISPICKVAL(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c,"Extension Pending"),Opp_Reg_Extension_Count__c>=3),"Maximum number of extensions have been reached.","")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Field needs to be blank to Submit for Approval, Extensions
CustomField.label: Missing for Approval - Ext
